component: Graph calendar discovery metadata and callback contract

quotes.text: void onCalendarDiscovered(in AUTF8String id, in AUTF8String name, in boolean readOnly);

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The follow-up requires each calendar ID and name, treats absent or null canEdit as false, and derives readOnly by negating that value. It sends each result through onCalendarDiscovered before the shared operation reports completion. The JavaScript promise accumulates those records and settles from onComplete. The added fake-server test directly checks one supplied ID/name and a writable calendar; it does not cover malformed metadata, null canEdit, multiple results or failure completion. Later persistence assertions are a separate phase. No network or test execution ran.
title: Graph discovery sends calendar metadata before its completion status
